dimensions.name: gross frontage
dimensions.basis: Allsop auction particulars; replaces OSM-derived 5.16 m width, retains Lakeland party line.

dimensions.name: shop depth
dimensions.basis: Allsop metric figure. Imperial conversion printed in PDF disagrees, metric retained.

dimensions.name: built depth
dimensions.basis: Allsop metric figure and aerial long plot; imperial figure disagrees.

dimensions.name: gable ridge above threshold
dimensions.basis: Street View gable apex slightly above Lakeland 16.3 m parapet; perspective and ground slope limit precision.

dimensions.name: main roof depth
dimensions.basis: Four Google3D views: short tall gabled front volume with lower rear range.

dimensions.name: rear two-storey depth
dimensions.basis: Aerial roof break, partially screened by adjoining roofs.

coverage.front: 2019 panoramas from two positions; 2017 auction photograph; May 2026 Arthur Belgrove shopfront photo. Main openings and gallery visible, carved motifs partly obscured.
coverage.roof: Google3D headings 0,89.5,179,268.5 degrees plus near-plan, inspected 2026-10-26. Ridge and long lower rear range visible; minor vents not reliable.
coverage.sides: Party walls; exposed upper gable sides seen in3D, no invented side openings.
coverage.rear: Aerial only; concealed courtyard/windows deferred. No street-level rear photograph obtained.
coverage.footprint: Measured frontage/depth against registered Lakeland boundary. Last metres of rear plot approximate, no claim of cadastral survey.
